summary.tldr: Adds political belief and political activity to the Canadian Human Rights Act’s protected grounds against discrimination.
what_it_does: Replaces section 2 of the Canadian Human Rights Act so its purpose statement includes political belief or activity among the discriminatory practices the Act addresses.
Replaces subsection 3(1) so political belief or activity becomes a prohibited ground of discrimination under the Act.
Keeps the other protected grounds in place, including race, religion, age, sex, disability and conviction for an offence with a pardon or record suspension.
who_it_affects: People covered by the Canadian Human Rights Act
Federally regulated employers and service providers
summary.background: The bill amends the Canadian Human Rights Act. That Act lists the grounds of discrimination that are prohibited under federal law.
